ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-20-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Blanca Moran was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor Marco Antonio Gomez. Petitioner was placed under oath and testified.
Proof of Publication in file. Proof of Service of Order to Show Cause for Change of Name in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Marco Antonio Moran.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-15-2008 Reset To May-20-08 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Blanca Moran was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, Marco Antonio Gomez, who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

Petitioner did not provide the Court with a Proof of Service indicating that the minor's father has been properly noticed of today's proceedings.

Good cause appearing, the Order to Show Cause for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to May 20, 2008 @ 9:00 a.m. in Department 218.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name of a Minor was submitted to and signed by the Court.
